findings.description: Complete mobile navigation; Profile and My Activity are distinct.
URL-backed search and filters; contextual View all and global-search handoffs.
Visible-scope result counts, explanatory empty states, reset, and matching alternatives.
Readable supporting text, placeholders, upload guidance, and stronger contrast.
Named search inputs, explicit pressed/current states, consistent view switches, visible keyboard focus.
Publishing, requests, membership, messages, notifications, and sample members describe local demo effects.
Progressive filters retain all capabilities, applied refinements, reset, and counts.
Home leads into the feed with one prominent creation entry per viewport.
Distinct decision hierarchy for posts, teams, competitions, people, and communities; fewer nested surfaces.
Recruit teammates opens the existing Team composer and safely restores any prior draft.
Featured competition collapses during filtering; result context stays consistent.
Community descriptions and existing related discussions lead; explicit Join/Leave and sample membership labels.
Five profile sections, canonical bio/skills/interests, concrete shared factors, and accurately labeled led teams.
Responsive dialog width fixed; desktop composer uses 42rem with mobile scrolling and sticky completion actions.
Safe contextual return links preserve originating query/filter state and direct-link fallbacks.
All posts replaces unimplemented For You; shared factors lead and retained relevance scores are explained.
44px shared/icon targets, larger uploader controls, forgiving mobile navigation, and focus indicators.
Consistent awaited request states, withdrawal, explicit Going/Cancel RSVP, and local error/success feedback.
Per-user/per-thread persisted message drafts; no fake typing/presence or image placeholders; search recovery.
Notification destinations, saved-category URL/counts, My Posts handoff, Following labels, and selected-event URLs.
Visible 3-interest/1-skill minimums with no maximum; returning login retains profile and onboarding completion.
Two-character comment rule matches enabled state, inline guidance/errors, and preserves unsent input.

limitations: Headless Chromium only; physical devices, mobile keyboards, Safari/Firefox, screen readers, and real zoom unverified.
Development reload timing and synthetic filter measurements are not production Core Web Vitals.
